final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(CAST(l.CPK AS REAL) / l.GPT) AS sex_average FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(sex_average) AS value FROM sex_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT s.sex_average, s.sex_average - f.value AS first_difference FROM sex_averages AS s JOIN first_average AS f ON f.value IS NOT NULL WHERE s.sex_average > f.value), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(sex_average) AS value FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT k.sex_average, k.first_difference, k.sex_average - a.value AS second_difference FROM first_kept AS k JOIN second_average AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL WHERE k.sex_average > a.value) SELECT AVG(sex_average), AVG(first_difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM final_kept
